royal-indigo.$description: Primary brand color. Logos, primary headers, hero web banners and buttons, core packaging box exteriors. Off-White Silk text on it: 10.4:1.

soft-violet.$description: Secondary accent. Promotional blocks, secondary buttons, offer highlights, boy/unisex variant tags. Off-White Silk text on it: 4.8:1 (AA). Never Midnight Slate text on it (2.8:1).

bright-sky.$description: Highlight accent. Trust badges ("100% Combed Cotton"), info highlights, WhatsApp/action buttons. Use Midnight Slate (6.2:1) or Royal Indigo (4.8:1) text on it; never Off-White Silk text (2.2:1).

petal-pink.$description: Soft accent. Gift ribbons, girl/unisex variant tags, gentle highlight badges, warm backgrounds. Use Midnight Slate (6.2:1) or Royal Indigo (4.8:1) text on it; never Off-White Silk text (2.2:1).

background.$description: Off-White Silk. E-commerce product staging, website and section backgrounds, social post canvases.

foreground.$description: Midnight Slate. All body text, sizing charts, packaging copy and garment wash care labels; dark backgrounds. 13.4:1 on the base background.

text.$description: Body text, sizing labels, care labels.

surface.$description: Page, section and social canvas background.

button-primary.$description: Hero web buttons and primary actions.

action-text.$description: Text on Bright Sky. Never Off-White Silk (2.2:1).

promo.$description: Promotional blocks, offer highlights and secondary buttons.

badge-trust.$description: Trust badges such as "100% Combed Cotton" and "AZO-Free Dyes".

badge-accent.$description: Soft accent and highlight badges on social graphics.

variant-tag.$description: Girl/unisex variant tags (Soft Violet for boy/unisex).

neutral.$description: Neutral scale for borders, dividers and muted text on the light base background.
